_why: Known failure patterns of the 'Ahmed Shaaban Shorts' instant clone (UeQ9UTIKgN2rsbnqHH5w) on eleven_v4, found in real Reels. engine/tts.py applies 'replace' to what the voice reads (captions keep script.md); engine/voicecheck.py --pre flags 'watch' patterns before any credits are spent. Add a row whenever a new failure is confirmed by ear, with where it was found.

replace.found: real-estate-never-loses v1 0:29: separate 'و' read as a stretched 'وا…' and 'مش كدة' as a tag question
real-estate-never-loses v1 0:46: 'إنت' read as Standard Arabic 'anta'
real-estate-never-loses v1 0:37: read 'تلاتة ملايين' (Standard Arabic plural)
preventive: digits before ألف risk Standard Arabic forms (see ٢٠٠)
real-estate-never-loses v2 0:20.6: 'و٢٠٠ ألف' heard as Standard Arabic 'ومائتي'

watch.why: a lone 'و'/'ف' followed by a space is read as its own stretched syllable; join it to the next word
digits before مليون/ألف/مليار may get Standard Arabic number agreement; write the Egyptian words out
a question followed by more text in the same paragraph is often read flat; end the paragraph after the question
may come out as Standard Arabic 'anta/anti'
Egyptian negation (مبيخسرش, مبتكسبش): listen that it is not read slowly as 'ما بي...'
